findings.summary: Autodesk 3ds Max is a professional Windows-only 3D computer graphics program used for modeling, animation, rendering, and game asset creation. It features non-destructive modifiers, a flexible plugin architecture, and integrated tools for character rigging, particle systems, global illumination, and texture workflows. The software uses C++, C, and Python and is widely adopted by game developers, visual effects studios, and architectural visualization teams.

mechanisms.title: Non-destructive modifier stack
mechanisms.explanation: Users edit geometry through modular layers applied atop base meshes, enabling adjustments or removals without permanent alteration of the original structure.

mechanisms.title: Character rigging and skinning system
mechanisms.explanation: Integrated Biped skeleton with IK/FK switching, weight maps, and envelope controls drives skeletal deformation; four plug-in IK solvers support high-quality character animation and motion capture integration.
